pages.text: Welcome to Moon's Whatsits!$(br2)This book covers the crops, food, drinks and music added by the mod.$(br2)Most of the entries explain what an item is, where it comes from, and what you can do with it.

The book is split into a few sections.$(br2)$(li)$(l:whatsits:crops)Crops$(/l) covers the plants and ingredients you can grow.$(br)$(li)$(l:whatsits:foods_drinks)Food & Drinks$(/l) covers the things you can make and eat or drink.$(br)$(li)$(l:whatsits:music)Music$(/l) covers the music discs and, where there's something interesting to say, where they came from.$(br2)More entries can be added here as the mod gets bigger.
